# UNHALT
Formerly BATTERY. Paused isn’t lost.

Concept: a checkpoint remains as a pause transforms into forward movement. One graphite foot joins a still pillar and the lime arrow-pillar. The flat SVG is the canonical small-size symbol; hero.webp is its sculptural interpretation, not an editable 3D model or exact perspective rendering of SVG.

Colours: paper #f3f2ec, graphite #22251e, lime #d6fa4b. System Arial / Helvetica for typography.
logo-1024.png: transparent symbol; banner.png: 1500×500 social cover; 32/44/180 variants; mark.svg: editable vector.
Existing domain and X handle are retained during the brand transition; no new token is issued or renamed onchain.
